description: This Java class `NullFeature` represents a feature with a JSON null value within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances with validation, as well as serialization to JSON. The class is immutable and provides various getter methods, but since it represents a null feature, most property-related methods do not hold data.

classes.name: NullFeature
classes.description: An immutable class representing a feature with a JSON null value within the Ditto model.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new NullFeature instance with validation to ensure the feature ID is valid and contains no control characters or slashes.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the feature.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the feature to a JSON object representing null.
